buildcraft.help.advanced_crafting.materi: Items stored here are used to craft the selected recipe automatically.
buildcraft.help.advanced_crafting.output: Completed items appear here. Extract them manually or with pipes.
buildcraft.help.advanced_crafting.previe: Shows the item that the current recipe would produce.
buildcraft.help.architect.input.title: Blank blueprint/template
buildcraft.help.architect.input.desc: Insert a blank blueprint or template here. The Architect Table records the marked area into it.
buildcraft.help.architect.output.title: Recorded blueprint/template
buildcraft.help.architect.output.desc: The finished blueprint or template appears here when recording is complete.
buildcraft.help.architect.progress.title: Recording progress
buildcraft.help.architect.progress.desc: Shows how much of the selected marker area has been scanned.
buildcraft.help.architect.name.title: Blueprint name
buildcraft.help.architect.name.desc: Name saved into the recorded blueprint/template.
buildcraft.help.architect.options.title: Recording options
buildcraft.help.architect.options.desc: Controls whether creative-only blocks are saved, whether the result can rotate, and whether excavation data is included.
buildcraft.help.assembly.ingredients.des: Place laser assembly ingredients here. Lasers supply MJ to craft matching assembly recipes.
buildcraft.help.assembly.recipes.title: Available recipes
buildcraft.help.assembly.recipes.desc: Possible outputs are shown here. Click a recipe to save or unsave it as an active target.
buildcraft.help.autoworkbench.recipe.des: Phantom recipe slots. Set the crafting recipe that this automatic workbench should perform.
Put crafting ingredients here. Pipes may insert matching materials automatically.
buildcraft.help.autoworkbench.result.des: Crafted items appear here once the recipe has enough materials.
buildcraft.help.autoworkbench.progress.d: Shows the current automatic crafting progress.
buildcraft.help.builder.blueprint.title: Blueprint/template slot
buildcraft.help.builder.blueprint.desc: Insert a recorded blueprint or template. The Builder will use it as the structure plan.
buildcraft.help.builder.resources.title: Resource inventory
buildcraft.help.builder.resources.desc: Put blocks and items required by the blueprint here. The Builder consumes them while constructing.
buildcraft.help.builder.required.title: Required items
buildcraft.help.builder.required.desc: Displays materials still required by the current build plan.
buildcraft.help.builder.fluids.title: Required fluids
buildcraft.help.builder.fluids.desc: Displays fluids used by schematics in the current blueprint.
buildcraft.help.builder.preview.title: Blueprint preview
buildcraft.help.builder.preview.desc: Shows a compact preview/resource area for the inserted blueprint.
buildcraft.help.chute.inventory.title: Chute inventory
buildcraft.help.chute.inventory.desc: Temporary item buffer used by the chute before items are moved downward.
buildcraft.help.chute.buffer.title: Drop buffer
buildcraft.help.chute.buffer.desc: Central buffer slot used while the chute pushes items into the world or inventory below.
buildcraft.help.engine.fuel_tank.title: Fuel tank
buildcraft.help.engine.fuel_tank.desc: Stores combustible fluid used by the combustion engine.
buildcraft.help.engine.coolant_tank.desc: Stores coolant. Coolant prevents combustion engines from overheating.
buildcraft.help.engine.residue_tank.desc: Stores residue produced when some fuels are processed.
buildcraft.help.filler.resources.title: Building resources
buildcraft.help.filler.resources.desc: Only block items are accepted here. The Filler consumes them when placing blocks.
buildcraft.help.filler.pattern.title: Filler pattern
buildcraft.help.filler.pattern.desc: Selects the pattern used inside the marked area: fill, clear, frame, pyramid, cylinder and others.
buildcraft.help.filler.work.title: Work status
buildcraft.help.filler.work.desc: Shows selected area state, remaining blocks to break/place, and work warnings.
Set phantom filter items here. They decide what the filtered buffer accepts or routes.
buildcraft.help.filtered_buffer.inventor: Real item storage used by the filtered buffer.

buildcraft.help.gate.connections.title: Gate connections
buildcraft.help.gate.connections.desc: Toggle which pipe sides this gate may interact with.
buildcraft.help.heat_exchange.input_a.de: First fluid input for the heat exchanger.
buildcraft.help.heat_exchange.output_a.d: First fluid output from the heat exchanger.
buildcraft.help.heat_exchange.input_b.de: Second fluid input for the heat exchanger.
buildcraft.help.heat_exchange.output_b.d: Second fluid output from the heat exchanger.

Items integrated into the target by the Integration Table.
buildcraft.help.integration.preview.desc: Shows the expected integrated item before crafting finishes.
buildcraft.help.integration.result.title: Result
buildcraft.help.integration.result.desc: The completed integrated item appears here.

buildcraft.help.library.list.desc: Saved blueprints/templates stored in the electronic library database.
A downloaded blueprint/template is placed here.
buildcraft.help.library.download_input.d: Insert a blank blueprint/template here to download the selected library entry.
buildcraft.help.library.upload_input.des: Insert a recorded blueprint/template here to upload it to the library.
buildcraft.help.library.upload_output.de: Uploaded items are returned here when the transfer finishes.
buildcraft.help.library.progress.title: Transfer progress
buildcraft.help.library.delete.title: Delete entry
buildcraft.help.list.name.title: List name
buildcraft.help.list.name.desc: The editable name stored on this list item. Pipes, robots, gates and other machines keep using the list data; this only changes the visible label.
buildcraft.help.list.reference.title: Comparison item
buildcraft.help.list.reference.desc: The first slot of each row is the item used as the reference for this filter row. In variation/material modes the rest of the row is generated from this item.
buildcraft.help.list.extra_entries.title: Extra slots / examples
buildcraft.help.list.extra_entries.desc: In normal mode these phantom slots store more accepted items. In variation or material mode they show example matches and cannot be edited directly.
buildcraft.help.list.precise.title: Exact match
buildcraft.help.list.precise.desc: Requires the item data to match exactly, including enchantments, custom names and stored NBT data.
buildcraft.help.list.type.title: Accept variations
buildcraft.help.list.type.desc: Matches variants of the comparison item, such as different damage values or subtypes. Enabling this mode keeps only the first slot as the reference item.
buildcraft.help.list.material.title: Accept equivalents
buildcraft.help.list.material.desc: Matches equivalent items made from the same material or tag/class. If both variation and material modes are enabled, the list uses the broadest class-style matching available.
buildcraft.help.list.entries.title: List entries
buildcraft.help.list.entries.desc: Phantom slots that define item matching rules for each line.
buildcraft.help.list.options.title: Match options
buildcraft.help.list.options.desc: Toggle exact NBT, variation and material matching for the selected list line.
buildcraft.help.pipe.diamond.filters.des: Each row filters items for one pipe side. Items matching a row are routed to that side.
buildcraft.help.pipe.emerald.filters.des: Items listed here are extracted or blocked depending on the selected mode.
buildcraft.help.pipe.emerald.mode.title: Filter mode
buildcraft.help.pipe.emerald.mode.desc: Switch between whitelist, blacklist, and round-robin extraction modes.
buildcraft.help.pipe.emzuli.filter.title: Output filter
buildcraft.help.pipe.emzuli.filter.desc: Sets what items may leave through this coloured output slot.
buildcraft.help.pipe.emzuli.paint.title: Paint selector
buildcraft.help.pipe.emzuli.paint.desc: Cycles the pipe colour assigned to the matching output slot.
buildcraft.help.programming.input.title: Board input
buildcraft.help.programming.input.desc: Insert a blank robot board here.
buildcraft.help.programming.output.title: Programmed board
buildcraft.help.programming.output.desc: The completed programmed board appears here.
buildcraft.help.programming.options.desc: Available board programs. Select the program to write onto the board.
buildcraft.help.silicon.progress.title: MJ progress
buildcraft.help.silicon.progress.desc: Shows how much MJ has been received for the current recipe.
buildcraft.help.tank.slot.title: Tank contents
buildcraft.help.tank.slot.desc: Shows the fluid stored in this tank.
buildcraft.help.architect.mode.title: Recording mode
buildcraft.help.architect.mode.desc: Creative mode records creative-only and otherwise unsupported blocks. Survival mode skips unsupported blocks.
buildcraft.help.architect.rotate.title: Rotation
buildcraft.help.architect.rotate.desc: Controls whether the recorded blueprint/template may be rotated when it is used later.
buildcraft.help.architect.excavate.title: Excavation data
buildcraft.help.architect.excavate.desc: Controls whether the blueprint/template records excavation information for clearing blocks before building.
buildcraft.help.charging_table.slot.desc: Insert a Forge Energy item. Lasers or BuildCraft MJ power pipes convert BuildCraft power into item charge. BuildCraft robots and blueprints are not Forge Energy items.
This table can be powered by lasers or directly by BuildCraft MJ power pipes. It only requests power when the recipe is valid, all materials are present, and the output can fit.
buildcraft.jade.engine.name: Engine: %s
buildcraft.jade.zone.name: Map name: %s
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.map: This panel shows the area around the Zone Planner. Left-click and drag to mark a rectangle on the selected layer. Right-click the map to recenter it on that point. Use the mouse wheel, +, or - to change zoom.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.lay: Each brush colour is a separate zone layer. Click a brush to choose which layer you are editing. Robots and gates can later use the exported Map Location for the selected layer.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.mod: The + / - button changes what dragging on the map does. In + mode selected blocks are added to the current layer. In - mode selected blocks are removed from it.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.ful: FS opens the map fullscreen. Shift+M also opens fullscreen. Press M or Esc to return to the normal Zone Planner window.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.nam: The text in this field becomes the name of the exported Map Location. Click the field to edit it. Press Enter or Esc, or click outside the field, to stop typing.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.cra: Put a blank Map Location in the top slot. After the progress bar fills, the lower slot receives a Map Location containing the currently selected zone layer and the name from the text field.
buildcraftrobotics.help.zone_planner.imp: Put an existing zone Map Location here to load its area into the selected colour layer. This is useful for editing a zone that was saved earlier.
buildcraftrobotics.help.requester.templa: Click a slot with an item stack on the cursor to set the requested item and amount. Click with an empty cursor, or shift-click the template slot, to clear it.
buildcraftrobotics.help.requester.storag: Delivery robots fill these slots until the matching request template is satisfied. Only items matching the template can be inserted into each slot.
The left side defines what is wanted. The right side stores what robots have delivered.
